title: 公路车外胎推荐丨马牌GP5000平替来了
notes: Creator test post (2025-01-25) presenting the R1 as a GP5000 alternative; the creator runs tire giveaways. Comments: one R1 cracked within 100 km and was returned; another owner had two R1 bulge within a month and replaced under warranty; the tubeless version was quoted at about CNY 250.
